author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I am pitching Opus 4.6 against GPT 5.3.  

Get them to write the same complex system, download all DVCon papers, clean up the data, upload to database, create AI enabled UI to let users chat with the papers.  

Both of them have been working hard for a few hours already, the job is still in progress.  I am so excited to see which one is better at the end. 

Stay tuned for the result.
